channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Malik Monk | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Malik Monk from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Perry on Malik Monk
item.description:
Kings GM Scott Perry on Malik Monk:

“I've had conversations with him both on the phone and in person here recently, and it's been very good. So we knew each other a little bit, getting to know each other a lot better now, so (I) look forward to working with him.”

Scott Perry on Malik Monk, Jul 15, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Malik Monk
item.description:
De'Aaron Fox on Malik Monk's free agency decision this summer:

“Him being able to be in this situation and obviously having multiple teams that are trying to come after him, I'm definitely happy for him. Obviously we want him to stay but, at the end of the day, he has to do what's best for him.”

De'Aaron Fox on Malik Monk, Jun 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @MattGeorgeSAC.

item.title: Mike Brown on Malik Monk
item.description:
Matt George:Mike Brown on Malik Monk:

“I truly believe Malik loves it here. The fans have done a fantastic job of showing him love. I think he really really appreciates that.”

Mike Brown on Malik Monk, Apr 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @MattGeorgeSAC.

item.title: Monte McNair on Malik Monk
item.description:
Kings GM Monte McNair on bringing back Malik Monk:

“He loves it here. We love him. So hopefully we'll do it when the time comes.”

Monte McNair on Malik Monk, Apr 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @MattGeorgeSAC.

item.title: Monte McNair on Malik Monk
item.description:
GM Monte McNair says

“Malik Monk is an elite shooter, fierce competitor and tremendous athlete. We’re thrilled to have him join us in Sacramento.”

Monte McNair on Malik Monk, Jul 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @SeanCunningham.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Malik Monk
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Anthony Davis on Malik Monk:

“We call him Microwave. Instant scorer. We still don't know how we got him for what we got him for.”

Anthony Davis on Malik Monk, Nov 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Robert Horry on Malik Monk
item.description:
“Malik Monk. We don’t get a chance to watch him being on the East coast as much. He came off and he played very well,”

Robert Horry on Malik Monk, Oct 5, 2021. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: James Borrego on Malik Monk
item.description:
James Borrego on Malik Monk's sprained ankle:

“I feel bad for the kid. He's been battling, he's given us a tremendous lift this season. So hopefully it's not too severe. We'll find out more tonight and tomorrow.”

James Borrego on Malik Monk, Apr 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: James Borrego on Malik Monk
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Borrego on Malik Monk's progress from missing 10 days with COVID-19:

“I've got to get him up to speed in conditioning... This virus is a major deal.”

James Borrego on Malik Monk, Dec 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Malik Monk
item.description:
Steve Clifford:

“With Malik Monk, then it became, ‘Do we play him over Jeremy?’ when (Lamb) is playing so well? For Malik to be an every-night starter, which he has the talent and potential to be, he’s going to have to play both spots. To be an every-night starter you have to play at both ends of the floor unless you can (score) 26 a night. You have to be able to guard your position. He is undersized, so to say he’s going to be a (shooting guard) every night against every player (is a stretch).I do think he can play both spots, but I don’t think it was in his best interest to use him the way that I did.”

Steve Clifford on Malik Monk, Feb 19, 2018. Source: Charlotte Observer.
